set.body:
Certify the revised image4s semantic kernel and authorize freezing the central public API.

Required evidence
- All semantic-hardening implementation and law-court children are closed with commit-specific receipts.
- Standalone image4s compileAll/testAll and optimized Scala.js links pass on the declared matrix.
- JDK 17 and JDK 21 CI pass; JVM/Scala.js/Node behavior is consistent.
- Allocation courts prove ranked access and zero-copy semantic/view wrappers add no whole-image allocation or hot-loop indirection.
- NIfTI malformed-input, dtype/scaling, exact-label, qform/sform, and representative large-volume courts pass.
- Registry concurrency tests pass without globally serializing unrelated tests.
- Binary compatibility/version policy is configured from the chosen public baseline.
- reframe4s and at least one medical/fMRI consumer compile and pass semantic checks against an immutable image4s revision.
- Documentation contains executable approachable examples for construction, time selection, crop/view, alignment/rebind, map, and aligned zip.

Freeze conditions
- Freeze only after the owner-type and intrinsic/ambient-dimension decisions are recorded and implemented.
- No unresolved alias claims, universal deep equality, hidden persistent-id generation, coordinate-losing axis path, fractional label API, arbitrary GridDomain identity, or dirty source composite remains.
- Tracker closure, local gates, Git commit, push, CI, downstream pin, and publication remain separately reported facts.

Tests
- Run the complete reusable law suite plus focused negative compile-time, concurrency, fuzz, allocation, large-volume, and downstream consumer courts.
- Re-run from a clean checkout at the exact candidate revision.
- Archive commands, source/runtime fingerprints, seeds, checksums, allocation receipts, workflow URLs, and supported-scope statement.
- A type-discipline review must find no casts, suppressed warnings, stringly semantic stuffing, sentinel identity, or phantom capabilities without construction evidence.
set.title: Certify the semantic kernel and authorize the image4s API freeze
